subject: LLP-Bench status: harness green, ranking instability risk
body:
Hi Bao, Dmitri,

Status: the harness milestone landed March 12. All nine methods run across feature_bags_ds, fixed_size_feature_bags_ds, and random_bags_ds, all five splits, and our numbers match the published ones within seed noise. Freya's analysis notebooks read straight from the metrics_dicts outputs.

The risk worth surfacing: method rankings are not stable across bag constructions. ot_llp and soft_erot_llp trade places between the feature-bag and random-bag settings, and dllp_bce looks deceptively strong on random bags only. If teams cherry-pick the construction that flatters their method, the "one benchmark" goal quietly dies. Proposal: the required reporting format is the full 3-construction x 5-split matrix, with a single aggregate rank only as a secondary summary. Slightly more compute per review, ~30 CPU-hours, but it closes the loophole.

One small thing - the autoint_embeddings generation is slower than expected, eta April 1 not March 27.

Csilla
